verdict.rationale: Stripe docs show payouts moving balance to bank accounts with dashboard tracking, plus separate refunds and disputes/chargebacks APIs, giving the raw building blocks for reconciliation, but there's no evidence of a dedicated itemized reconciliation report that ties settlements to bank deposits with fees/refunds/chargebacks broken out in one artifact. missing for 10: explicit itemized settlement/reconciliation report documentation, fee breakdown per payout, and any finance-ops-specific reconciliation workflow or corroborating independent evidence.
